description: Authoritative list of the 543 Lok Sabha (Indian Parliament lower house) Parliamentary Constituencies (PCs) as established by the 2008 Delimitation Commission order. Each PC is the geographic unit that elects one Member of Parliament (MP). Records include state code/abbreviation, PC code, PC name, and PC type (GEN/SC/ST reservation status). Compiled by DataMeet from Election Commission of India (ECI) source records.
